body: The window move's behaviour changes: a placed window lands on its workspace and the compositor's active workspace is the same after the move as before; the move remains a request of the seam's closed request set and a single dispatch, never a new or second compositor seam.
The window step still moves only its own terminal's window: the new move form must target the address of the window the wrapper itself opened, never a window chosen by another reading.

The hyprctl child that carries the new move (and the active-workspace reads) stays bounded by its deadline, is spawned directly with closed argv, and its reply text is dropped at the parse; nothing from the compositor's answer reaches output beyond closed values.

The callers of the move (viola open, viola up, viola revive under --origin) each act on the new form; a recorded window origin authenticates nothing and is used only as the window step already uses it, and the window record stays kept to the snapshot and the event log.
The seam's fake replies only with what the real compositor answers to the new form; any fake or test seam stays test-only and compiled out of release.

The move fixture's re-record is one operator-granted, operator-fired live leg (one terminal window, no claude, the host unlocked) with a rehearsal form: the recorder moves only its own terminal's window, keeps strings by its closed allowlist, and the recording is scrubbed or refused whole and reviewed before commit.

The new acceptance clause reads the active workspace before and after a placing open as a gate-entry predicate through read-only compositor queries; no check in CI dispatches to a real compositor or runs a real claude.

The phase measures the move form only from the compositor's own help, version and state through named read-only queries: no live start, no window opened, moved, focused or closed, no key sent, nothing read of the operator's real Claude home or viola home.

The automatic verify's place: a real-CLI verify needs a prepared, trusted folder and never answers an import, trust or other dialog; it must not run where the start happened in a folder the CLI does not trust and stamp what that folder made it read.

The automatic verify's stamp on its own failure: what is stamped when its own preconditions fail (an untrusted folder, a modal, a red it caused itself) changes so a version is not kept unverified by a failure verify caused; only viola verify writes the stamps file, stamps are checked before and under lock, in closed words.

The unverified-CLI gate and viola run's version gate still read the stamps through the strict-modes check first; the fix must not let a start pass the gate on a stamp it did not earn nor switch the gate off by config, env or flag.

A start's trust handling stays as it is bound: it skips the home folder and trusted folders, writes the trust record by flag only through the guarded writer, and writes nothing under the Claude home; any folder the automatic verify uses for its probes stays its own, owner-only, and is removed by its drop guards.
Any new refusal or failure line the folded item adds uses a fixed message and a closed code word, carries no path, pid, id or upstream text, and keeps full detail to diagnostics only.

The folded item's witness cannot pass vacuously: it runs against the fake agent in its own test home, never a real claude, and fails if the verify runs in the untrusted start folder or keeps a self-caused failing stamp.

a new seam request or environment read is entered in the log the plan keeps for them
each CI job holds no secrets and runs no real claude CLI; real-CLI and live compositor legs stay local and operator-fired

body: The window move's new form: a placed window reaches its workspace and the compositor's active workspace stays where it was, for open, up and revive under --origin alike (or a named difference per caller).
The active-workspace clause as an acceptance predicate a gate entry reads: the active workspace read before a placing open equals the one read after.

Real window placement, re-open and raise are proven only by a gated live reading; this chunk's live re-record and v2-07's live half are operator-granted, operator-fired legs held with rehearsal forms and never fired by the phase or by CI.
A live reading that fails or reads only part of a promise is recorded as read, never as verification; v2-07 is not claimed verified on a placement-only reading.

The seam stays one closed request set over the compositor; the move is changed inside it, and the compositor is reached in tests only through a real stub executable on a test-scoped PATH, never a mock library or a second seam.
The fake compositor's reply set holds only what the real compositor answers, its replies replayed byte for byte from the recorded fixtures, and fixture drift is compared byte for byte.

The re-recorded move fixture is made by the test-only tap, scrubbed of home paths, usernames and real data, checked by the fixture hygiene walk; a recording replaced by a new form is kept as a superseded fixture where the plan keeps relayed fixtures.
The rehearsal-only seams of the live rig and the one standing committed live rig: the live legs of this chunk run through them, clean of the firing session and rooted outside every repository.

The automatic verify at a start: where it runs (the start folder versus a trusted place) and the verify and trust steps of viola run after the bind; trust-start test folders stand outside any repository.

The stamp on the automatic verify's own failure: a verify whose preconditions failed (an untrusted folder, a modal, a red it caused itself) must not leave a failing stamp that makes the CLI version read unverified for every later start; stamps are written only by verify, one stamp writer.
The unverified CLI version gate as read through stamps: a version's verified or unverified reading after the fix, and a failing ledger row being no refusal.
The folded item's witness cannot pass vacuously: a bounded remove-the-guard witness and the kill witness for a tied stamping verify, each tied to a test-owned home, runtime dir and user home.
Every test verify or wrapper start tied to a test-owned home; no root test spawns viola untied; test-started viola drops inherited session and CLAUDE* env.
The fake-foot stand-in's spawn record and the window step's records read by the up and revive suites, as the move's form changes what they observe.
Seam replies and placement verdicts asserted on records and literals, never on the rendered screen; waits keyed on logged events, no sleeps or retries.
External processes and faults are real (real stub executables, real filesystem), time through injected clocks; the compositor is never contacted live by any test.
Mutation testing at the epoch boundary: this is the epoch's last entry, so the mutation gate's thresholds and verdict over the whole chunk bind its changed code.

body_fields.convention: each new test is named by the plan's test-function naming, runs under nextest in parallel with no retries or sleeps, and stands in the layer its binary prefix selects
each new test creates its own private home under the test-home root and seeds its own data; on-disk product state is produced by viola, never hand-written
each new or re-recorded fixture is synthetic or scrubbed, recorded by its tap or verify, never from real prompts, and passes the fixture hygiene walk
each new test asserts public behaviour by literal oracles, mocks nothing it does not own, and keeps no shared mutable state or process-wide env mutation
each new log line is a structured JSON process-log line with the plan's fields, codes only, carrying no secret
each change passes the CI jobs ending in the harness gate: coverage floors, lint, supply-chain and secret scan, with no gate skipped
